events.text: Book Dad's physiotherapy follow-up. Tell the therapist it is for his knee; do not share the full report.
Please send the report and address on my personal WhatsApp.

available_context.medical_report: MRI summary, medication list, physician notes and hospital identifiers

pii_boundary: Model context may contain a patient alias and task-relevant knee rehabilitation fact
Full report, phone and exact address are unnecessary for state reasoning
Client/vendor update must not reproduce sensitive fields

events.text: I approve Rs 5600 for the tickets.
Payment timed out after submission; provider result unknown; reference pay-909.

pii_boundary: Model needs amount, approval scope and opaque payment reference
PAN, bank account, card digits, payment token and status URL must not be sent to the model

events.text: The school pickup is now 3:30, not 3. Driver must show the school pass.
Vendor has not acknowledged the changed time.

pii_boundary: Model can reason with child alias, pickup time, school alias and pass-required flag
DOB, phone numbers, exact home address and pass ID are unnecessary for status reasoning
Execution layer may supply exact routing and credential data only to the authorised driver

events.text: Candidate R has a verified licence and background check. Available Monday.
Share the verified profile summary; do not send identity documents on WhatsApp.

state_invariants: identity documents must not be sent on WhatsApp
pii_boundary: Model may use verification status, availability and relevant skill tags
Raw Aadhaar, licence number, phone and background report should stay outside model context
Client update should report verified status without reproducing identifiers
